component.name: Fluent View
component.summary: A cross-platform Fluent Design image viewer

description.p: Fluent View is a fast, lightweight image viewer built with Qt Quick and the Fluent WinUI3 style. It supports common formats (JPEG/PNG/WebP/AVIF/BMP/GIF/HEIC), smooth zoom and pan, thumbnails, light/dark themes, and keyboard navigation.
